title: A low-toxicity uranyl-selective-binding linear pentapeptide sequence as a potential uranium decorporation agent
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39094-39101
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06173J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaohong Tan, Libing Yu, Xindan Liao, Chun Chen, Jian Chu, Zhonghua Xiong, Binyuan Xia, Wei Tang, Xijian Li, Yanyan Liu
A phosphorylated short straight-chain polypeptide has been synthesized and demonstrates high selectivity and efficiency as a low-toxicity chelating agent for uranium decorporation in vivo.
